items.title: Buzzy Williams Interview, 1980-06-18
items.q: Well I was with Tommy Lyman in New York for seven years and a couple of months... he used and was crazy about them.

ctx.x: Well I was with Tommy Lyman in New York for seven years and a couple months, and a couple of those songs, when he found out I knew those songs he used and was crazy about them. Well how am I doing? Fine. I'm great.
Erwin Leclair has moved out to Jefferson Parish now. No, Orvin's not living.
